meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase Event Time with default 15‑minute option updates end time

plan.title: Increase live RFQ time by 15 minutes

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event without searching or creating another event.
Navigate to the RFQ stage referenced by the case.
Reach the Responses tab before opening the event settings action.
Open Extend Submission Time, choose the 15-minute preset, save it, and verify the end time moved 15 minutes later.
Verify the expected confirmation toast appears after the extension.
